# symbolicSparseMatrixProductTest.py

You can view and download this file on Github: [symbolicSparseMatrixProductTest.py](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/tree/master/python/TestModels/symbolicSparseMatrixProductTest.py)

```{code-block} python
:linenos:

#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
# This is an EXUDYN example
#
# Details:  SparseMatrix of exudyn.symbolics.utilities (#3199): a band matrix of 20 and of 100 rows whose entries depend
#           on the variables, its products A v and A^T v against the dense exudyn.symbolic.Matrix - the values and the
#           one-pass derivative to the bit, esym.Jacobian to the rounding of its other sums, the numbers of operations
#           and the times -, s A, A + B and
#           the numpy export; a chain of springs of ObjectGenericODE2 whose stiffness matrix is a SparseMatrix of the
#           coordinates, recorded against Python. The result is the final first coordinate plus the number of checks
#           that pass.
#
# Author:   Johannes Gerstmayr
# Date:     2026-11-01
#
# Copyright:This file is part of Exudyn. Exudyn is free software. You can redistribute it and/or modify it under the terms of the Exudyn license. See 'LICENSE.txt' for more details.
#
#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

import exudyn as exu
from exudyn.utilities import * #includes itemInterface and rigidBodyUtilities
from exudyn.symbolics.utilities import SparseMatrix
from exudyn.symbolics.codeExport import ToFunction
import numpy as np
import time

esym = exu.symbolic
passed = 0

def Band(n, q, p):
    """the triplets of a band matrix whose entries depend on q and p"""
    return [(i, j, (2. if i == j else -1.)*p*(1 + 0.1*q[i]*q[j])) for i in range(n) for j in [i - 1, i, i + 1] if 0 <= j < n]

def Time(function, *arguments, repetitions=200):
    start = time.perf_counter()
    for k in range(repetitions):
        function(*arguments)
    return 1e6*(time.perf_counter() - start)/repetitions

for n in [20, 100]:
    variables = esym.VariableSet()
    (q, p) = (variables.Add('q', np.zeros(n)), variables.Add('p', 1.))
    A = SparseMatrix(n, n, Band(n, q, p))
    dense = A.ToDense()
    results = {'sparse': [A @ q, A.T @ q], 'dense': [dense @ q, dense.T @ q]}
    (x, pValue) = (np.linspace(0.1, 1., n), 1.3)
    functions = {kind: [esym.Function(result, variables, kind) for result in results[kind]] for kind in results}
    jacobians = {kind: [esym.Function(esym.Jacobian(result, q), variables, kind) for result in results[kind]] for kind in results}
    (difference, differenceJacobian) = (0., 0.)
    for k in range(2):
        (sparse, dense_) = (functions['sparse'][k], functions['dense'][k])
        difference = max(difference, np.max(np.abs(np.array(sparse.Evaluate(x, pValue)) - np.array(dense_.Evaluate(x, pValue)))),
                         np.max(np.abs(np.array(sparse.EvaluateJacobian('q', x, pValue)) - np.array(dense_.EvaluateJacobian('q', x, pValue)))))
        differenceJacobian = max(differenceJacobian, np.max(np.abs(np.array(jacobians['sparse'][k].Evaluate(x, pValue))
                                                                   - np.array(jacobians['dense'][k].Evaluate(x, pValue)))))
    exu.Print(n, 'rows,', A.nnz, 'entries: sparse against dense, values and one-pass derivatives:', difference,
              ', esym.Jacobian (other sums):', differenceJacobian,
              '; operations', esym.GetStatistics(results['sparse'][0])['tableOperations'], 'against',
              esym.GetStatistics(results['dense'][0])['tableOperations'],
              '; evaluation %.1f against %.1f us, Jacobian %.1f against %.1f us' % (
                  Time(functions['sparse'][0].Evaluate, x, pValue), Time(functions['dense'][0].Evaluate, x, pValue),
                  Time(functions['sparse'][0].EvaluateJacobian, 'q', x, pValue), Time(functions['dense'][0].EvaluateJacobian, 'q', x, pValue)))
    passed += int(difference == 0.) + int(differenceJacobian < 1e-14)

#numbers, the operations of the matrices and the export
numbers = SparseMatrix(4, 4, Band(4, np.linspace(0.1, 0.4, 4), 2.))
v = np.array([1., -2., 0.5, 3.])
B = SparseMatrix.FromMatrix([[0., 1.], [2., 0.]])
checks = [np.array_equal(numbers @ v, numbers.ToDense() @ v), np.array_equal(numbers.T @ v, numbers.ToDense().T @ v),
          np.array_equal((3*numbers).ToDense(), 3*numbers.ToDense()), np.array_equal((numbers + numbers).ToDense(), 2*numbers.ToDense()),
          B.nnz == 2 and B[1, 0] == 2. and B[0, 0] == 0.]
variables = esym.VariableSet()
(q, p) = (variables.Add('q', np.zeros(4)), variables.Add('p', 1.))
Numpy = ToFunction(esym.GetFlatProgramData([SparseMatrix(4, 4, Band(4, q, p)) @ q], arguments=[q, p]), 'numpy')
checks.append(np.max(np.abs(Numpy(np.linspace(0.1, 0.4, 4), 2.) - SparseMatrix(4, 4, Band(4, np.linspace(0.1, 0.4, 4), 2.)) @ np.linspace(0.1, 0.4, 4))) < 1e-15)
exu.Print('numbers, s A, A + B, FromMatrix, export:', checks)
passed += int(all(checks))

#a chain of springs whose stiffness depends on the coordinates, as SparseMatrix in the forceUserFunction
nChain = 10
def UFforce(mbs, t, itemNumber, q, q_t):
    return -(SparseMatrix(nChain, nChain, Band(nChain, q, 100.)) @ q) - 0.5*q_t

simulationSettings = exu.SimulationSettings()
simulationSettings.timeIntegration.numberOfSteps = 200
simulationSettings.timeIntegration.endTime = 1
simulationSettings.timeIntegration.verboseMode = 0
simulationSettings.timeIntegration.newton.relativeTolerance = 1e-12
simulationSettings.solution.file.write = False
results = []
for record in [False, True]:
    SC = exu.SystemContainer()
    mbs = SC.AddSystem()
    node = mbs.AddNode(NodeGenericODE2(referenceCoordinates=[0]*nChain, initialCoordinates=list(np.linspace(0.1, 0., nChain)),
                                       initialCoordinates_t=[0]*nChain, numberOfODE2Coordinates=nChain))
    chain = mbs.AddObject(ObjectGenericODE2(nodeNumbers=[node], massMatrix=np.eye(nChain), forceUserFunction=UFforce))
    if record:
        recording = CreateSymbolicUserFunction(mbs, UFforce, 'forceUserFunction', chain)
        mbs.SetObjectParameter(chain, 'forceUserFunction', recording)
        mbs.variables['recording'] = recording #it lives as long as the system
    mbs.Assemble()
    mbs.SolveDynamic(simulationSettings)
    results.append(np.array(mbs.GetNodeOutput(node, exu.OutputVariableType.Coordinates)))
difference = np.max(np.abs(results[1] - results[0]))
exu.Print('chain of springs, recorded against Python:', difference)
passed += int(difference < 1e-12)

u = results[1][0] + passed
exu.Print('solution of symbolicSparseMatrixTest=', u)
exu.sys['testResult'] = u
```
